decls.lean:
def tw_blobCount : List Nat → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | h :: t => bif Nat.beq h 0 then 0 else 1 + tw_blobCount t

def tw_bumpGo : List T_Entry → Nat → Nat → Nat → List T_Entry
  | [], _, _, _ => []
  | e :: t, pos, skip, w => (bif (Nat.blt 0 pos && !(Nat.beq pos skip)) then { e with f_bdf := e.f_bdf + w } else e) :: tw_bumpGo t (pos + 1) skip w

def tw_anyGo : List T_Ch → Nat → Nat → Nat → Bool
  | [], _, _, _ => false
  | c :: t, i, lo, hi => (((Nat.ble lo i) && (Nat.ble i hi)) && ((!(Nat.beq c.f_c 0)) && (!c.f_f))) || tw_anyGo t (i + 1) lo hi

def tw_clearGo : List T_Ch → Nat → Nat → Nat → List T_Ch
  | [], _, _, _ => []
  | c :: t, i, lo, hi => (bif ((Nat.ble lo i) && (Nat.ble i hi)) then hz_Ch else c) :: tw_clearGo t (i + 1) lo hi

def tw_zeroCsr : List T_Entry → List T_Entry
  | [] => []
  | e :: t => { e with f_csr := 0 } :: tw_zeroCsr t

def tw_setLastCsr : List T_Entry → Nat → List T_Entry
  | [], _ => []
  | [e], r => [{ e with f_csr := r }]
  | e :: t, r => e :: tw_setLastCsr t r

def tw_tagsExact : List T_Entry → Bool
  | [] => true
  | e :: t => (bif Nat.beq e.f_ver 2 then Nat.beq e.f_tag 2 else !(Nat.beq e.f_tag 2)) && tw_tagsExact t
def tw_hdrOf (e : T_Entry) : List Nat := [e.f_ver, e.f_tot, e.f_n, e.f_hb, e.f_prev, e.f_post, e.f_lbn]

def tw_goLoop : Nat → Bool → Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, _, nc, _ => nc
  | _ + 1, true, nc, _ => nc
  | p + 1, false, nc, nl => tw_goLoop p (Nat.ble nl (nc + (nc + 768) / 4)) (nc + (nc + 768) / 4) nl

def tw_goNextcap (nl oc : Nat) : Nat :=
  bif Nat.blt (oc + oc) nl then nl else bif Nat.blt oc 256 then oc + oc else tw_goLoop nl false oc nl

def tw_firstGe : List Nat → Nat → Nat
  | [], n => n
  | h :: t, n => bif Nat.ble n h then h else tw_firstGe t n

def tw_overlay : List Nat → List Nat → List Nat
  | [], _ => []
  | h :: t, [] => h :: t
  | _ :: t, b :: r => b :: tw_overlay t r

def tw_put : List Nat → Nat → List Nat → List Nat
  | [], _, _ => []
  | h :: t, 0, bs => tw_overlay (h :: t) bs
  | h :: t, p + 1, bs => h :: tw_put t p bs

def tw_zeros : Nat → List Nat
  | 0 => []
  | p + 1 => 0 :: tw_zeros p

def tw_goRead (hp : List T_Arr) (sl : T_Sl) : List Nat :=
  List.take sl.f_len (List.drop sl.f_off (hl_nthD hp sl.f_b hz_Arr).f_cells)

doc: Lean twin of the target libraries the M1 fact documents use (spec/M1/lib/morph_rollup.lib.json and spec/lib/go_slices.lib.json), hand-written target input for holon.gen.lean_machine (I43 rule L1; gap LP-G2: common mode, like the Bend library). It is not a *.lib.json file, so it stays outside the generator closures' library glob. builtins: DSL function name -> {arity, lean: a Lean term template ($0..$9 the compiled arguments, $args all of them space-separated, ${param:NAME:DEFAULT} a facts parameter), type: the DSL type, kind and default as in the Bend library}. decls: Lean declarations emitted inside namespace Model after the generic helpers (hl_*) and the zero records (hz_<record>), in order, when the facts declare every type of when_types. shadow: the record the shadow projections read and, per shadowed field, the Lean term of a projected element ($0 the element; default: its field). Each declaration is the Bend library's definition read again: structural recursion, Bool conditions through Nat.beq/Nat.ble/Nat.blt.
